## Music
- "Stories About the World That Once Was", "That Hopeful Future Is All I've Ever Known", "Your Mother's Daughter" and "I Should Have Been More Human" by Chris Zabriskie, from the album Music from Neptune Flux. Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.

## Sound effects
- Sound effects from Epidemic Sound (owner's subscription; files not redistributed). Roles and IDs: assets/sfx/EPIDEMIC_SFX.md.

## Narration
- AI voice: Kokoro TTS v1.0 (Apache 2.0), designed voice Archive (style blend bm_fable 0.40 + am_michael 0.40 + bm_lewis 0.20, speed 0.92). Disclose as altered / synthetic content on YouTube (box ticked: Yes).

## Maps and graphics
- Terrain and bathymetry: Mapzen / AWS Terrain Tiles (open data). Modern aerials: USGS National Map imagery and USDA NAIP orthophotos (public domain).
- Photo depth moves: Depth Anything V2 Small (Apache 2.0).
- Approximate on the maps: the tow route, yard dots (representative, not all 87), the sanctuary outline (BOUNDARY APPROXIMATE on screen), the Sandy Point farm outline, the hull shapes drawn in the bay, the Atlantic routes.
